root.name: テキサス・パシフィック・ランド

rows.ja: 土地・水・データセンターの提携先

companies.name: ホライゾン・キネティクス

relations.text: 大株主のHorizon KineticsがTPLと取締役の選任に関する契約を結ぶ(2026年5月)
relations.text_en: Major shareholder Horizon Kinetics signed a board representative agreement with TPL in May 2026

source.label: Horizon Kinetics 8-K(2026年5月)
source.quote: entered into a Board Representative Agreement (the "Agreement") with Texas Pacific Land Corporation, a Delaware corporation ("TPL").

relations.text: 石油・ガスやロイヤルティ関連に投資するファンドで、TPLの株式にも投資
relations.text_en: A private fund investing in oil, gas and royalty assets, including Texas Pacific Land shares

source.label: PBT Land & Minerals 上場届出書(S-1/A)
source.quote: SoftVest, L.P. is a private investment fund that primarily invests in oil and gas and royalty related assets, including interests in public companies such as Texas Pacific Land Corporation

relations.text: 2025年10月、ウェルズ・ファーゴなどと最大5億ドルの回転信用枠の契約を締結
relations.text_en: Signed a revolving credit facility of up to $500 million with Wells Fargo and other lenders in October 2025

source.label: Texas Pacific Land 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: On October 23, 2025, we entered into a credit agreement with Wells Fargo Bank, National Association and certain other lenders

companies.name: ボルト・データ&エナジー

relations.text: 5,000万ドルを出資し、TPLの土地で大規模データセンター群と関連インフラを開発する戦略的契約
relations.text_en: Invested $50 million under a strategic agreement to develop large-scale data center campuses and infrastructure on TPL land

source.label: Texas Pacific Land の発表(Boltとの戦略的契約)
source.label_en: Texas Pacific Land release (Bolt strategic agreement)
source.quote: to develop and enable large-scale data center campuses and su pporting infrastructure across TPL land.

relations.text: シェブロンがテキサス州リーブス郡で開発するデータセンター向け発電所(Project Kilby)に、土地と水を提供する契約
relations.text_en: Agreed to supply land and brackish water for Chevron's Project Kilby power plant for a data center in Reeves County, Texas

source.label: Texas Pacific Land 2026年第2四半期決算発表
source.label_en: Texas Pacific Land Q2 2026 results release
source.quote: Announced an agreement with a Chevron Corporation (NYSE: CVX) ("Chevron") subsidiary to provide land and brackish water resources for Chevron's recently announced development known as Project Kilby

relations.text: LandBridge・WaterBridgeとTPLが、相互の通行権と産出水のロイヤルティ分配で契約
relations.text_en: LandBridge, WaterBridge and TPL agreed on reciprocal crossing rights and sharing of produced-water royalties

source.label: LandBridge 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: we and WaterBridge entered into agreements with Texas Pacific Land Corporation ("TPL"), one of the largest landowners in Texas, to provide reciprocal crossing rights and produced water royalty and revenue sharing across an area of mutual interest

relations.text: LandBridge・WaterBridgeとTPLが、相互の通行権と産出水のロイヤルティ分配で契約
relations.text_en: LandBridge, WaterBridge and TPL agreed on reciprocal crossing rights and sharing of produced-water royalties

source.label: LandBridge 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: we and WaterBridge entered into agreements with Texas Pacific Land Corporation ("TPL"), one of the largest landowners in Texas, to provide reciprocal crossing rights and produced water royalty and revenue sharing across an area of mutual interest
